serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #Landlord.Face.Grin Landlord: Sorry to disappoint, maggot. I shouldn’t even be surprised… #Landlord.Face.Unhappy You: What do you want, Mr. Landlord? There’s no way I will ever listen to what you have to say, so how about you change your appearance to Ben Affleck? Landlord: You think you make the rules here?! Don’t make me laugh! Your existence is so insignificant that you are not in control even in your mind! How can a person like that even dare to voice any objections?! #Landlord.Face.Surprised You: As annoying as ever. #Landlord.Face.Unhappy You: What? Surprised I talked back? You have no power over me here. You aren’t a real landlord, you can’t threaten me with raising my rent or kicking me out. I can insult you as much as I want and you can’t do anything about it! #Landlord.Face.Grin Landlord: Well, well, well… You finally got it, huh. Maybe there’s still hope for you, after all… Landlord: Since it seems like you regained some of your mental capability thanks to beating others, how about we move on to the topic at hand? You: Whatever, I have no choice in the matter. Just keep talking. Landlord: I will. And just so you know, that attitude isn’t impressing anyone. Landlord: Anyway. Today’s topic is: ‘Why even bother with other people?’ You: What the hell is that even supposed to mean? Landlord: You can pretend you don’t know, but we both know better. That thought keeps circling in your head, even though you have tried time and times to bury it. Landlord: You always pretended to wonder: Mommy! Mommy! Why did my girlfriend leave me?! You: I never said any of that… Landlord: You know why she left you. She left you because you had nothing to offer. Landlord: She wasn’t getting anything from that relationship so she took her chances to look for an upgrade. #Landlord.Face.Normal You: Yeah, she was a bitch. Landlord: Can you really blame her? Just look at you. Landlord: Besides, didn’t you do the same with your mommy? As soon as she stopped sending money you all of a sudden remembered her old faults. How convenient! You: What are you trying to say? Landlord: That you are a hypocrite! A hypocrite that can’t face the truth! You: And what is that truth exactly? Landlord: That all of those relationships are just transactions! #Landlord.Face.Grin Landlord: You hate the landlord more than anyone else because he lives by something you know is correct, but you refuse to accept it because of your weaknesses. Landlord: World can’t be this cruel! It’s not true! #Landlord.Face.Unhappy Landlord: Stop being a child, it’s time to grow up and accept it. This world centers around money, power, sex… {{wi}}It’s so pathetic to look at what you do from here. Playing house with that bot of yours, pretending to be friends with shop clerks. That Big Daddy guy? You couldn’t find a more sketchy creep in the whole megacity! Landlord: But you refuse to see it! Nobody likes you! Nobody loves you! It’s all a matter of convenience! Everyone just follows their best interest, but you took it upon yourself to prove it all wrong. To be nice and dandy… Landlord: And what exactly did you get from all of it? You overcommit, believe in things that aren’t there and get hurt. Landlord: Friendship and marriage are simply transactions like any other, but they were romanticized by society! Landlord: Going back to the Middle Ages, the most valuable marriages were being arranged. Elders knew that love is nothing more than an illusion that gets in the way of a good business. Landlord: Why is it always you that gets the short end of the stick? You need to break the cycle! Reject these useless emotions! #Landlord.Face.Grin Landlord: Stop pretending! Let it all go! Embrace this cruel world and learn how to thrive in it! #Landlord.Face.Normal You: Living like that would be so painful… Landlord: Isn’t it painful already? How much did you hurt? Your ex, your college friends, your dad, your mom. They left your life and didn’t look back while you were crying alone in your little flat. Landlord: You can’t be hurt if you have no expectations. #Landlord.Face.Surprised You: But what about {f_botName}? I have her now. Am I supposed to close my heart to her too? Landlord: You must be joking... She’s just a bunch of wires! You are getting attached to an object! #Landlord.Face.Unhappy You: I refuse to believe that! She’s much more advanced! She’s not an object! #Landlord.Face.Normal Landlord: Fine, keep your bot. After all, she’s much more convenient than a real human. You can just hardcode her love for you and- #Landlord.Face.Surprised You: I would never do that! Landlord: What? Why?! That’s just dumb! Do you want to lose her too?! #Landlord.Face.Unhappy You: It’s true that I was hurt many times, and for that reason, I started avoiding people, but I refuse to become some kind of emotionless ghoul! Landlord: I see. So you won’t admit the truth. Fine by me. It seems like you weren’t hurt enough. Knowing your luck it’s just a matter of time before you make the same mistakes and finally break. You: I won’t allow it to happen. #Landlord.Face.Grin Landlord: Ha! Like you have any choice on the matter! #Landlord.Face.Unhappy Landlord: I’m sick of this childishness. Let’s get this duel started and be done with it! In 3… {{wi}}2… {{wi}}1!
